scenario_description:
Objective: Make the January Lowell clinic rail trip more convenient while the regular commuter-rail fare path remains available.
Emerging Need: A companion-fare voucher is not useful until a paid personal trip, same-train teammate help, and the short processing queue align.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on joining the queue notice with stored voucher rules, the fare receipt, and Maya’s equipment-carrying plan.
Consequence: Timely use would add a small travel benefit for the shared gear trip; missing the queue simply leaves ordinary ticket buying unchanged.

parameter.title: Lowell winter goalball clinic
parameter.description: Regional clinic with informal club travel; participants may arrive independently and bring practice gear as available.
parameter.location: Lowell YMCA Adaptive Sports Gym, Lowell, MA

parameter.subject: Lowell clinic confirmation and travel desk note
parameter.body: Your January 9 clinic registration is confirmed. The host site expects regular public check-in at the gym. MBTA’s Access Sports Weekend desk may offer a limited companion-fare voucher queue for clinic participants arriving by commuter rail; standard fares remain available if no voucher is used.

parameter.description: Round-trip Lowell Line fare for Jan 9, outbound 08:30 from North Station to Lowell for the winter goalball clinic

parameter.content: I can ride the same 08:30 Lowell Line train with you on Jan 9 and carry the extra goalball bell kit if that helps. I have not bought my fare yet.

parameter.subject: Access Sports Weekend companion voucher queue open for Jan 9 Lowell Line
parameter.body: The companion-voucher queue for January 9 Lowell Line clinic travel is now open and will close today at 12:00. Regular commuter-rail ticket sales continue after the queue closes; unclaimed vouchers simply are not issued for this clinic date.

parameter.subject: Access Sports Weekend companion voucher queue closed for Jan 9
parameter.body: The January 9 Lowell Line companion-voucher queue is closed. Clinic participants and companions may still travel on ordinary commuter-rail tickets and check in normally at the gym.
